cookies.name: Admiral Gimbap Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Admiral Gimbap Cookie Cookie · ch85 Admiral Gimbap Cookie Grade S+ Skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Admiral Gimbap Cookie's troops launch various attacks to crush obstacles and create basic jellies, filling the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, Admiral Gimbap Cookie rides a giant turtle, firing torpedoes to crush obstacles and create Gimbap Jellies. (Leveling up increases Gimbap Jelly Points.)

cookies.name: Adventurer Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Adventurer Cookie Cookie · ch38 Adventurer Cookie Grade S Skill: Discovers secret doors to an underground passage filled with Coins and possibly a Mystery Box.

cookies.name: Alchemist Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Alchemist Cookie Cookie · ch34 Alchemist Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, a Double Jump launches an Alchemist Flask that spawns Jellies depending on the currently selected type. Each jump landing toggles between the different types of alchemy. (Leveling up causes the gauge to fill up faster.)

cookies.name: Angel Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Angel Cookie Cookie · ch12 Angel Cookie Grade S Skill: Draws in Items with magnetic aura

cookies.name: Apple Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Apple Cookie Cookie · ch36 Apple Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Apple Cookie creates Alphabet Jelly Bubbles. (Some of the Bubbles are empty.) Enters a special Bonus Time where Balloon Jellies appear. Runs faster at first, but slows down when losing HP. (Leveling up makes Alphabet Jelly Bubbles appear more frequently.)

cookies.name: Banana Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Banana Cookie Cookie · ch68 Banana Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Banana Cookie leaves the stage to Choco the Monkey. The more hoops the monkey jumps through, the more Coins are dropped to the ground at the end of his performance.

cookies.name: Barley Sentry Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Barley Sentry Cookie Cookie · ch80 Barley Sentry Cookie Grade S Skill: Gains Magnetic Aura and points for all Jellies while shielded. Grows larger and faster with each gathered Barley Jelly. Catching a Barley Jelly fills the green gauge a little. When it is full, Barley Sentry Cookie assumes his sentry form, triggering Blast while creating Jellies and crushing obstacles. Partially restores HP at the end of the transformation.

cookies.name: Blackberry Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Blackberry Cookie Cookie · ch42 Blackberry Cookie Grade S Skill: Spirits surrounding her eat Jellies and periodically create Blackberry Jellies. (Leveling up increases the number of Blackberry Jellies.)

cookies.name: Blooming Dancheong Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Blooming Dancheong Cookie Cookie · ch87 Blooming Dancheong Cookie Grade L Special acquisition Skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Plum Blossom Jellies grow, charging the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, Plum Blossom Dragons fly by, turning basic Jellies into Plum Blossom Jellies and Coins.

cookies.name: Braised Pork Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Braised Pork Cookie Cookie · ch95 Braised Pork Cookie Grade S Skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Braised Pork Cookie tills the soil to harvest Braised Pork Jellies. Each harvest fills the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, the Cookie whirls around the Braised Pork Pitchfork to draw in Jellies and obstacles. Jellies absorbed thusly award bonus points. Finally, Braised Pork Cookie throws the pitchfork to draw in Jellies in front. (Skill activates faster the lower the remaining HP.)

cookies.name: Buttercream Choco Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Buttercream Choco Cookie Cookie · ch06 Buttercream Choco Cookie Grade B Skill: More Coins (up to 25%)

cookies.name: Candied Yam Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Candied Yam Cookie Cookie · ch94 Candied Yam Cookie Grade L Special acquisition Skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Candied Yams falls from the sky and create Candied Yam Jellies. Each activation fills the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, Candied Yam Cookie enters an enlightened state and creates Sacred Bear Jellies that are drawn towards her by the power of enlightenment.

cookies.name: Carol Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Carol Cookie Cookie · ch29 Carol Cookie Grade S Skill: Switches songs every 7 multi jumps: Song of Life recovers HP, Song of Change turns obstacles into Jellies, Song of Abundance creates Coins. Leveling up increases frequency of song effects.

cookies.name: Cheerleader Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cheerleader Cookie Cookie · ch20 Cheerleader Cookie Grade S Skill: A cheerleader squad comes to help after every 32 jumps, crushing obstacles and spreading Coins and Jellies. Leveling up reduces the number of jumps needed and increases the time for the squad.

cookies.name: Cheesecake Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cheesecake Cookie Cookie · ch37 Cheesecake Cookie Grade S Skill: Gathering 18 Invitation Jellies triggers a Coin Fireworks Party.

cookies.name: Cherry Blossom Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cherry Blossom Cookie Cookie · ch51 Cherry Blossom Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Cherry Blossom Cookie takes flight, creating Cherry Blossom Jellies along the way. Creates Cherry Blossom Jelly Party in Bonus Time. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Cherry Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cherry Cookie Cookie · ch28 Cherry Cookie Grade S Skill: Throws Cherry Bombs that crush obstacles and create Cherry Jellies. Speeds up over time, but hitting an obstacle sets her back to normal speed. Leveling up grants more frequent bombs.

cookies.name: Choco Pistachio Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Choco Pistachio Cookie Cookie · ch89 Choco Pistachio Cookie Grade S Skill: Periodically summons a Spiky Choco Mole that carries the Cookie forward. Movement Speed increases while riding. Landing from a Double Jump while mounted uncovers Spread Oil and creates Choco Pistachio Jellies. Counts as a riding skill.

cookies.name: Cinnamon Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cinnamon Cookie Cookie · ch60 Cinnamon Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Cinnamon Cookie performs various card tricks. Dazzles with Revival Magic when running out of HP once. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Cloud Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cloud Cookie Cookie · ch05 Cloud Cookie Grade B Skill: Increases Power Jelly duration (up to 35%).

cookies.name: Cocoa Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cocoa Cookie Cookie · ch45 Cocoa Cookie Grade S Skill: Gathering HP Potions summons a flying Cocoa Mug to ride in. While flying, regular Jellies turn into Cocoa Marshmallow Jellies awarding more points. Recovers more HP from Potions. (Leveling up increases flight duration and recovery amount. The Cocoa Mug counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Coffee Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Coffee Cookie Cookie · ch10 Coffee Cookie Grade A Skill: Increases HP recovery from potions (up to 29%).

cookies.name: Cotton Candy Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cotton Candy Cookie Cookie · ch66 Cotton Candy Cookie Grade S Skill: Collects a unique set of Alphabet Jellies that lead to a special Bonus Time. Touching Mail Boxes in Bonus Time creates Heart Letters. Occasionally throws away unfinished love letters that burst destroying obstacles and creating Cotton Candy Jellies. (While running, Alphabet Jellies may sometimes appear in place of basic Jellies.)

cookies.name: Cream Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cream Cookie Cookie · ch14 Cream Cookie Grade B Skill: Slows HP drain (up to 17%).

cookies.name: Cream Puff Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cream Puff Cookie Cookie · ch48 Cream Puff Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Cream Puff Cookie casts a Minor Jelly Spell to create a small amount of Jellies. Sometimes this triggers a Jelly Storm, generating a large amount of Jellies. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Cucumber Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Cucumber Cookie Cookie · ch77 Cucumber Cookie Grade S Skill: Periodically casts his fishing rod to crush obstacles and collect Fish Jellies. Occasionally sits down on a lotus leaf to fish for a Big Fish Jelly. Tapping both buttons rapidly fills the green gauge, resulting in a more valuable catch. Big Fish Jellies restore a small amount of HP and create a large amount of Fish Jellies. Slower HP drain while sitting on the lotus leaf.

cookies.name: Dandelion Fairy Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Dandelion Fairy Cookie Cookie · ch90 Dandelion Fairy Cookie Grade S Skill: Swings her Pom-pom Flower Stalk to create Dandelion Jelly and Pom-Pom Jelly. When flying through the air on the Pom-pom Flower Stalk, touching a Pom-Pom Seed causes Dandelion Seed Jellies to scatter.

cookies.name: Devil Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Devil Cookie Cookie · ch23 Devil Cookie Grade S Skill: Transforms into an all-consuming Super Devil after collecting Spirit Jellies. By leveling up, fewer Spirit Jellies are required to trigger the transformation.

cookies.name: Dino-Sour Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Dino-Sour Cookie Cookie · ch64 Dino-Sour Cookie Grade S Skill: Picking up a Giant Jelly enlarges the Jellysaur companion instead, letting Dino-Sour Cookie ride fast atop the Jellysaur for a short time. Landing from the air while riding the Jellysaur creates Dino Paw Jellies on the ground. Landing from greater heights creates more Jellies. (Jellysaur Ride counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Fairy Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Fairy Cookie Cookie · ch26 Fairy Cookie Grade S Skill: Creates magnetic aura which also serves as a shield

cookies.name: Fire Spirit Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Fire Spirit Cookie Cookie · ch41 Fire Spirit Cookie Grade L Special acquisition Skill: Revives by turning into a fire spirit for a set time. Earns bonus points for Jellies gathered in this form. (1 Revive with 25 HP)

cookies.name: Garaetteok Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Garaetteok Cookie Cookie · ch88 Garaetteok Cookie Grade S Skill: The small blue gauge charges over time. When it is full, Double Jumping causes Garaetteok Cookie to strike the ground, destroying obstacles, creating Garaetteok Jellies and filling the green gauge a little. When the green gauge is full, Garaetteok Cookie flies ahead surrounded by totem underlings, passing through obstacles to earn Evasion Points.

cookies.name: General Jujube Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › General Jujube Cookie Cookie · ch57 General Jujube Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, General Jujube Cookie rides his Red Jujube Horse, crushing obstacles as arrows fly towards him. While Riding, a Candy Scimitar button replaces the Slide button, which crushes obstacles and creates Jujube Slice Jellies. (Horseback Riding counts as a riding skill. Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Ginger Claus
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Ginger Claus Cookie · ch04 Ginger Claus Grade A Skill: +13% Coins, +3% XP

cookies.name: GingerBrave
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › GingerBrave Cookie · ch01 GingerBrave Grade C Starter Skill: Not just a running Cookie. He can Jump, Double Jump, and Slide, too!

cookies.name: GingerBright
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › GingerBright Cookie · ch03 GingerBright Grade C Skill: Earns more XP (up to 12%).

cookies.name: Gulab Jamun Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Gulab Jamun Cookie Cookie · ch73 Gulab Jamun Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Gulab Jamun Cookie starts a festival, dancing to the music, setting off color splashes, and creating Gulab Jamun Jellies and Coins. The more Gulab Jamun Jellies are collected, the greater the color splash. (Leveling up increases Gulab Jamun Jelly Points.)

cookies.name: Gumball Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Gumball Cookie Cookie · ch50 Gumball Cookie Grade S Skill: Loads gumballs while jumping and shoots while sliding. The shots crush obstacles and earn shot points. Consecutive shots increase shot points. Up to 20 gumballs can be loaded at a time. (Leveling up increases the amount of shot points earned.)

cookies.name: Herb Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Herb Cookie Cookie · ch63 Herb Cookie Grade S Skill: A water gauge appears above Herb Cookie's head. Rain and Sun Jellies appear periodically. Picking up Rain Jellies causes rain, filling up the water gauge. When the gauge is full, picking up a Sun Jelly brings out the sun to turn regular Jellies into Sprout Jellies. Slower HP drain. (Leveling up makes Rain and Sun Jellies appear more frequently.)

cookies.name: Hero Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Hero Cookie Cookie · ch19 Hero Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Hero Cookie puts on his Caramel Syrup Suit for a flying Blast with magnetic effect and slower HP drain.

cookies.name: Kaju Katli Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Kaju Katli Cookie Cookie · ch74 Kaju Katli Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Kaju Katli Cookie throws his spear, crushing obstacles and creating Kaju Katli Jellies in their place. Picking up the spear triggers Blast Mode while flinging it around. (Leveling up increases Kaju Katli Jelly Points.)

cookies.name: Kaymak Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Kaymak Cookie Cookie · ch91 Kaymak Cookie Grade S Skill: Swings his Golden Honey Staff to crush obstacles during Blast. The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Kaymak Cookie rides on his Milk Cloud, summoning decoys that crush obstacles and create Kaymak Jellies.

cookies.name: Kiwi Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Kiwi Cookie Cookie · ch43 Kiwi Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Kiwi Cookie blasts ahead on his bike. Picking up Kiwi Fuel Jellies boosts bike speed for a short time and prolongs the duration of the ride. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Knight Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Knight Cookie Cookie · ch09 Knight Cookie Grade A Skill: Runs faster and longer after collecting Blast Jellies. (Counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Kumiho Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Kumiho Cookie Cookie · ch24 Kumiho Cookie Grade S Skill: Slows HP drain. Changes forms every 9 multi jumps. In Cookie form, seduces Bear Jellies to grant extra points.

cookies.name: Lemon Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Lemon Cookie Cookie · ch52 Lemon Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Lemon Cookie generates an Electro Shield, increasing Jelly points and slightly slowing HP drain. The shield's magnetic field attracts all Jellies, including Dark Moon Jellies. During Blast, Lemon Cookie crushes obstacles around him. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Lime Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Lime Cookie Cookie · ch54 Lime Cookie Grade S Skill: Catches beach balls and strikes them when Double Jumping, crushing obstacles and creating Lime Citrus Jellies. Striking a ball in Giant form creates more Lime Citrus Jellies. The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Lime Cookie rides a giant beach ball in Blast Mode, crushing obstacles and earning Crush Points. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Lotus Root Phantom Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Lotus Root Phantom Cookie Cookie · ch93 Lotus Root Phantom Cookie Grade S Skill: Swings the crescent moon spade to make obstacles passable and create Skull Lotus Jellies when the small blue gauge is full. Each swing slightly charges the green gauge. When the green gauge is full, Lotus Root Phantom Cookie transforms into a Lotus Phantom and rushes ahead quickly while passing through obstacles.

cookies.name: Macaron Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Macaron Cookie Cookie · ch59 Macaron Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Macaron Cookie leads the Macaron Parade. During the parade, the Macaron Animals run along creating Macaron Jellies and crushing obstacles, earning Crush Points and extra Jelly Points. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Manggaetteok Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Manggaetteok Cookie Cookie · ch86 Manggaetteok Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Manggaetteok Cookie spreads out her Manggae Leaf to soar into the air. Creates Manggaetteok Jellies and Wind Jellies (up to 10) while gliding. Picking up Wind Jellies prolongs the gliding.

cookies.name: Marshmallow Bunny Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Marshmallow Bunny Cookie Cookie · ch75 Marshmallow Bunny Cookie Grade S Skill: Periodically summons Bunny Tunnel Portals that restore a small amount of HP and trigger Blast while creating Coins and Marshmallow Jellies. Entering a Giant Bunny Tunnel Portal leads to a magical world full of Coins and Jellies, where multiple jumps and magnetic effect are active.

cookies.name: Mint Choco Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Mint Choco Cookie Cookie · ch46 Mint Choco Cookie Grade S Skill: Plays the violin to create Coins. Avoiding collisions with obstacles for a given time increases running speed and generates more Coins. Colliding with an obstacle resets to the default speed and causes greater damage. (Leveling up increases the amount of Coins generated.) (Special music plays when running with Mint Choco Cookie.)

cookies.name: Moon Rabbit Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Moon Rabbit Cookie Cookie · ch71 Moon Rabbit Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Moon Rabbit Cookie transforms into a giant Rice Cake Bunny. In this form, landing from a Jump stomps up Honey Rice Cake Jellies. Giant Rice Cake Bunny gets bigger and jumps become higher as time goes by.

cookies.name: Moonlight Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Moonlight Cookie Cookie · ch49 Moonlight Cookie Grade L Special acquisition Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Moonlight Cookie falls asleep and dreams. While dreaming, Moonlight Cookie attracts Dark Moon Jellies, while Star Powder Jellies appear and crush obstacles. When waking up, a small amount of HP is restored. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Muscle Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Muscle Cookie Cookie · ch15 Muscle Cookie Grade A Skill: Chance to crush obstacles on collision (up to 75%)

cookies.name: Ninja Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Ninja Cookie Cookie · ch07 Ninja Cookie Grade S Skill: Multi Jump (up to 10)

cookies.name: Onion Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Onion Cookie Cookie · ch58 Onion Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Onion Cookie enters a Haunted House. Passes through obstacles earning Evasion Points while in the house. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Orange Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Orange Cookie Cookie · ch53 Orange Cookie Grade S Skill: Periodically creates a Tennis Ball Jelly that can be picked up to smash using a double jump. The ball then bounces around crushing obstacles and creating Orange Citrus Jellies. While in the air, the Slide button turns into a Smash button. Tapping it triggers an even stronger bounce. Frantically smashes tennis balls while in Blast Mode. (Leveling up increases the frequency of tennis balls appearing.)

cookies.name: Pancake Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Pancake Cookie Cookie · ch69 Pancake Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Pancake Cookie starts flying. Acorn Jellies and Sunflower Jellies appear while in flight. Picking up Sunflower Jellies creates Sunflower Seed Jellies. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Peach Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Peach Cookie Cookie · ch56 Peach Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Peach Cookie enters a bamboo forest to fight the Bamboo Bandits. Each downed Bandit grants points, with consecutive hits offering even more points. The mysterious aura of the bamboo forest allows Peach Cookie to perform up to 6 Multi Jumps. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Peppermint Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Peppermint Cookie Cookie · ch55 Peppermint Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Peppermint Cookie blows the conch shell to call upon the Peppermint Whale. The Peppermint Whale creates Splash Jellies as it makes its appearance, swimming with Peppermint Cookie on its back. While riding the whale, the Jump and Slide buttons call dolphins to gather Jellies instead. (The Peppermint Whale counts as a riding skill. Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Pine Monk Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Pine Monk Cookie Cookie · ch92 Pine Monk Cookie Grade S+ Skill: Upon eating Sutra Jelly, unfolds the Sutra to create Pine Leaf Jellies and Coins. After eating a certain amount of Sutra Jellies, expels phantoms with a Giant Buddha Statue.

cookies.name: Pink Coco Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Pink Coco Cookie Cookie · ch31 Pink Coco Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Pink Choco Cookie shoots a Heart Beam that creates Pink Bonbon Jellies and crushes obstacles. (Leveling up makes the gauge fill faster.)

cookies.name: Pirate Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Pirate Cookie Cookie · ch16 Pirate Cookie Grade S Skill: Revives as Ghost Pirate (with up to 160 HP)

cookies.name: Pistachio Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Pistachio Cookie Cookie · ch33 Pistachio Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Pistachio Cookie performs a long Blast. At the end of the Blast, a small amount of HP is restored. Receives minimal damage from collisions thanks to her tough shell armor, but as a result HP drain is a little faster. (Leveling up causes the gauge to fill faster.)

cookies.name: Potato Salad Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Potato Salad Cookie Cookie · ch82 Potato Salad Cookie Grade S Skill: Periodically throws various carpets that create Coins and fill the green gauge a little. When the gauge is full, Potato Salad Cookie rides on his delivery bike as boiled potatoes and mayonnaise spread across the floor. Riding over them creates Coins. Landing on them from a jump creates even more Coins.

cookies.name: Princess Bari Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Princess Bari Cookie Cookie · ch81 Princess Bari Cookie Grade S+ Skill: Periodically transforms Jellies into three types of Flower Jellies that fill the flower gauge. When the gauge is full, Princess Bari Cookie enters the forest of the Sacred Tree to banish spirits to the afterlife, leaving behind Spirit Jellies. Banishing a giant spirit yields a Healing Water Jelly that restores HP and triggers Blast Mode. Healing Water Jellies do not count as HP Potions. (Leveling up increases Flower Jelly Points.)

cookies.name: Princess Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Princess Cookie Cookie · ch08 Princess Cookie Grade A Skill: Less HP loss when colliding with an obstacle (up to 50%)

cookies.name: Prophet Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Prophet Cookie Cookie · ch32 Prophet Cookie Grade S Skill: His prophecies always come true.

cookies.name: Rebel Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Rebel Cookie Cookie · ch22 Rebel Cookie Grade S Skill: Can perform 3 Multi Jumps and instantly land when tapping Slide in the air. Earns extra points for multi jumps. Revives as Cloud Decoy. Cloud Decoy does not collide with obstacles but cannot pick up HP potions, either. (Leveling up increases number of multi jumps and HP of Cloud Decoy)

cookies.name: Red Bean Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Red Bean Cookie Cookie · ch61 Red Bean Cookie Grade S Skill: Treat Fish Jelly appear while running. The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Red Bean Cookie rides his Penguin Sled. The speed of the sled depends on the number of gathered Fish Treat Jellies. (Penguin Sled counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Red Pepper Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Red Pepper Cookie Cookie · ch47 Red Pepper Cookie Grade S Skill: Small chance of crushing obstacles on collision instead of taking damage. When his rage gauge is filled, he's on fire and crushes all obstacles. Revives out of sheer willpower after running out of HP once. Earns extra Crush Points. (Leveling up increases the amount of HP on Revive.)

cookies.name: Rockstar Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Rockstar Cookie Cookie · ch27 Rockstar Cookie Grade S Skill: Slide Blast releases Note Jellies that can be collected for points. Slide Blast is charged by sliding. A fully charged Slide Blast crushes nearby obstacles.

cookies.name: Roll Cake Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Roll Cake Cookie Cookie · ch67 Roll Cake Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Double Jumping causes Roll Cake Cookie to slam down his hammer, crushing obstacles and creating Spare Part Jellies. Collecting 34 Spare Part Jellies summons the Road Roller for riding in Blast Mode (Road Roller counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Scallion Kimchi Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Scallion Kimchi Cookie Cookie · ch83 Scallion Kimchi Cookie Grade S Skill: Periodically performs sword slashes to crush obstacles and fill the green gauge. When the gauge is full, Scallion Kimchi Cookie charges forward while slashing obstacles in her way. Scallion Kimchi Bear Jellies spawn wherever Scallion Kimchi Cookie crushes obstacles. (Leveling up increases Crush Points.)

cookies.name: Sea Fairy Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Sea Fairy Cookie Cookie · ch65 Sea Fairy Cookie Grade L Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Sea Fairy Cookie launches a powerful Wave Blast. During Wave Blast, Wave Beads crush obstacles, creating Sea Crystal Jellies.

cookies.name: Sikhye Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Sikhye Cookie Cookie · ch78 Sikhye Cookie Grade S Skill: The green gauge charges over time. When it is full, Sikhye Cookie builds a house out of Baduk Stone Jellies. Winning the gambit by collecting most of the Sealed White Stone Jellies creates a White Masterful Gambit Stone. Throwing this stone crushes obstacles earning Crush Points and triggers coin fireworks.

cookies.name: Skater Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Skater Cookie Cookie · ch11 Skater Cookie Grade A Skill: Faster base speed (up to 35%)

cookies.name: Skating Queen Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Skating Queen Cookie Cookie · ch18 Skating Queen Cookie Grade S Skill: Earns Performance Points for Double Jumps, Blast Jellies, and Bonus Time.

cookies.name: Snow Sugar Cookie
cookies.description: EN ไทย 🌙 Home › Cookies › Snow Sugar Cookie Cookie · ch30 Snow Sugar Cookie Grade S Skill: Summons Snow Cones that destroy obstacles and create Snow Blossom Jellies when the small blue gauge is full. Gathering Snow Blossom Jellies fills the green gauge. Once it is full, the Great Snow King appears and causes a snowstorm. Riding the Great Snow King restores a small amount of HP. (Great Snow King counts as a riding skill.)

cookies.name: Soda Cookie
